report.explanation: All current gateway telemetry is healthy: 0.1% error rate, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts, zero db pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the alert's claimed error-rate and latency spike, so no bounded root-cause candidate is supported. Downstream services are only visible via topology, with no telemetry. Handing off for evidence of the actual anomaly.
